scope: Offline image-goal planning; recorded context resets every two seconds; no robot execution.
reference: Go2 sport local odometry (meters/radians), not independent motion-capture ground truth.
metric_aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of complete 2 s plans; ATE and RPE are computed by the repository paper evaluator, then converted to meters with the fixed Office-Go2 waypoint scale.
spacing_policy: Frozen pretrained Office-Go2 scale; not fitted to this evaluation recording.

camera_alignment.time_origin: First ego frame timeline_ns (host receive clock).
camera_alignment.ego_mapping: Nearest original frame on exact timeline_ns; resampled at 15 Hz on host time.
camera_alignment.uncertainty_kind: Approximate visual review tolerance; not a statistical or physical synchronization bound.

events.event: final stop after returning to box

camera_alignment.review: Initial departure and final stop reviewed in 0.1 s contact sheets; route, doorway and turn sequence checked throughout at 8 s intervals.

visualization.layout: Third-person main view; equal-size first-person GT and model views below; trajectory, goal and metrics in a fixed right column.
visualization.sample_selection: Nearest 4 Hz sample; both GT ego and model frames share sample index. Third-person video follows continuous aligned time.
visualization.aspect_ratio: Model 224x224 and identically preprocessed GT are displayed at 4:3, reversing the training square resize.
visualization.trajectory_plot: Current robot frame; forward upward, left leftward; equal metric scale; no path smoothing.
